train_segmentor_with_config: train a segmentation model using a config file path and optional work directory
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from an auto-detected or specified checkpoint path in the work directory
enable_amp_training: enable automatic mixed precision training by switching the optimizer wrapper to AmpOptimWrapper
override_config_options: override config settings at runtime using key=value pairs merged into the config file
launch_distributed_training: launch distributed training jobs using pytorch, slurm, or mpi launchers with local rank support
